notes.text: The full article editor is available at /new after login. If login returns to the homepage, navigate to /new again to reach the complete editor instead of the homepage status box.

For DEV long-form posts, use #article-form-title for the title, #tag-input for comma-separated tags, and #article_body_markdown for the markdown body. Publishing navigates directly to the final article URL.
[success verification] Published the DEV article at https://dev.to/[username]/[article-slug] and verified the final page title plus the GitHub and Mac App Store links in the article body.

workflows.name: Create and publish a DEV long-form post
workflows.description: Open the full editor, fill title tags and markdown body, then publish and verify the final article URL.
steps: Log in to DEV and navigate to /new
Fill #article-form-title with a problem-led title that includes the product name when appropriate
Fill #tag-input with up to four comma-separated tags
Fill #article_body_markdown with the full markdown body
Click Publish and wait for navigation to the final article URL
Verify the final page title plus the key links in the published article body
